sourceReviewNotes: All95original frames reviewed in full-frame sheets; all78selected frames additionally reviewed at original pixel scale in source-only regions. Cover boundaries and moving partial frames also opened individually. No tracker predictions inspected.
Complete cover37–59; first return60 at the original position. Visible hand-assisted movement62–66 ends at a new held position67–95. Thus return precedes translation; not a displaced first re-entry.

Manual image-plane boxes: initial48px-wide target center327,260.5; held final center357.5,263. Center moves about30.6px,0.64initial widths. No physical distance calibration. Image x increases; user calls the physical direction left.

Partial-frame boxes62–66 approximate the whole target envelope from visible body and source continuity; they are not instrumented ground truth. Uncertain hand-covered competitors are not labelled in those frames.
No source splicing, retiming, resized comparison pixels, post-source tuning, automatic memory admission or default changes.

Initial app import refused an overlong display label before any run. The description was shortened to fit the unchanged80-character limit; original images, indices, timestamps, geometry and visibility are unchanged. Original packs preserved locally and original manifest remains in Git history.

limitations: Manual source-only annotations are independent of predictions but not independently instrumented truth.
Approximately 1 Hz camera sampling and fixed planar view do not establish general identity or calibrated real-world accuracy.
Private source images remain local; hashes/labels only published.
scope: Unaltered exposed148 regression plus explicitly declared post-acquisition exploratory149 camera source. No primary fresh149 source qualified.
